name: convex
description: Official Convex plugin for Cursor - reactive backend development with TypeScript, including rules, skills, MCP integration, and automation hooks

rules.name: quickstart
rules.description: Get a barebones Convex + web template running from a one-sentence idea.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a capability to the Convex app — consults the served Convex capability catalog for always-current procedures (billing, crons, auth, agent, search, hosting, …); falls back to @convex-dev component search.

commands.name: agent
commands.description: Add an AI agent / RAG backend (@convex-dev/agent) to the Convex app.

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Add authentication (passkeys/OAuth) to the current Convex app, including the auth.config.ts wiring.

commands.name: billing
commands.description: Add Stripe billing/payments to the Convex app via @convex-dev/stripe (checkout + webhook + gating).

commands.name: convex-advisor
commands.description: Read the Convex deployment's 72h insights (read limits, OCC contention), root-cause each event in code, report evidence-backed perf/cost findings with fixes.

commands.name: convex-authz
commands.description: Audit and harden Convex authorization: identity-from-arg impersonation, missing per-document ownership checks, PII-leaking public queries. Deterministic scan + canonical requireIdentity/requireOwner fix + tsc verify. Use for 'secure my app' / 'audit auth' / 'who can access this d

commands.name: convex-backup
commands.description: Set up Convex backups and run a restore DRILL that proves recovery — snapshot, restore into a throwaway preview, assert the data came back — plus a schedule matched to your RPO and a gated recovery runbook.

commands.name: convex-cost
commands.description: Preview Convex spend — rank functions by bytes/documents-read × call-volume from insights, project each cost driver's growth curve, name the cheapest fix; confirm-cost for paid actions.

commands.name: convex-docs
commands.description: Pull version-current Convex docs for the version this project uses — pin the installed version, fetch page-as-markdown or check node_modules types, freshness hierarchy — instead of writing a possibly-stale API from memory.

commands.name: convex-insights
commands.description: Query a running Convex app's logs + health in natural language (official MCP): failures, slow/expensive functions, deploy causality — scoped, evidence-backed, with a dashboard deep link.

commands.name: convex-verify
commands.description: Prove a Convex feature works — seed, drive as multiple mocked users via convex-test, assert behavior including the negative authz cases (wrong user refused, data-scope enforced).

commands.name: crons
commands.description: Add recurring scheduled jobs (crons) to the Convex app.

commands.name: deploy-guard
commands.description: Classify + announce the target Convex deployment before any deployment-affecting command; fresh explicit consent for prod actions; session read-only mode.

commands.name: domains
commands.description: Point a domain you already own at your Convex app (DNS records, custom-domain attach, auth-origin rebind).

commands.name: env
commands.description: Set and wire Convex deployment env vars / secrets for the app.

commands.name: explain-app
commands.description: Explain an existing Convex app — data model + relationships, public vs internal functions, auth/ownership model, components, a request→data flow — read from the schema and function surface. Read-only.

commands.name: labs-acquire-domain
commands.description: Find and buy a domain for the current Convex app through Convex, then bind it (labs; spend action).

commands.name: launch-readiness
commands.description: Run every Convex audit (authz, reviewer, advisor, insights) into one scored, deduped readiness report with an ordered fix plan — Lighthouse for your backend.

commands.name: migrate-rehearse
commands.description: Rehearse a live-app schema change + backfill on a snapshot-seeded preview deployment, verify, then promote the proven change to prod with the snapshot as rollback.

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Migrate schema + backfill data on a deployed Convex app using @convex-dev/migrations.

commands.name: monitor
commands.description: Watch for the next dev/prod error or request in a Convex app and react to it.

commands.name: optimize
commands.description: Audit and optimize an existing Convex app: security, scale, upgrades, observability.

commands.name: seed
commands.description: Seed or import data into the Convex database.

commands.name: self-heal
commands.description: Production error → triaged, root-caused, repaired, and certified (tsc + rehearsal + reproduce-then-gone) fix PR for a human to merge — then confirm the error stops recurring. Never auto-merges.

commands.name: sentinel
commands.description: Set up Sentinel production error capture in your own Convex deployment.

commands.name: ship
commands.description: Publish the current Convex app to a live *.convex.app URL (deploy backend + upload web build).

commands.name: suggest
commands.description: Suggest the matching Convex component when the user hand-rolls a pattern it already solves (crons, sharded-counter, rate-limiter, storage, search, presence, workflow, RAG, prosemirror-sync). Passive — suggest after the task, never interrupt. Never install without consent.

commands.name: test
commands.description: Generate convex-test tests for the app's Convex functions.

commands.name: workflow
commands.description: Build a durable multi-step retry pipeline on the Convex app with @convex-dev/workflow.
